description: This file defines the EmployeeAddress class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for encapsulating employee address details within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as street, city, province, zipcode, and country, with methods to generate a string representation of the address. It interacts with the Country entity to resolve the country name from a stored identifier.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: A DTO class representing an employee's address, capable of producing a string representation of the address, resolving the country name if a country ID is provided.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the address properties with provided values or null.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a formatted string of the address components, including resolving the country name if applicable.
